source.name: Liquipedia
source.method: the Elo of every 3v3 series of Liquipedia's S-, A- and B-Tier events from 2015-09-10 to the end of 2025 (docs/design/rocket-league.md, "Earlier seasons")
source.conversion: rating = Elo / 25 − 2, rounded; each newcomer started at his region's level as the games to 2025-12-31 measure it (APAC 1009, EU 1500, MENA 1392, NA 1488, OCE 1232, SAM 1298, SSA 1006; fitted at once with every player's own strength, Europe's at 1,500: docs/design/rocket-league.md, "Regions")
